what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission elected Dave McDonald chair by roll call, with an abstention, John Reynolds vice chair and Brett Ransom clerk.
The board asked the business manager to rewrite the regulation so final bills are prorated monthly, with a new draft due at the next meeting.
The board moved meetings to 6:00 p.m. starting next meeting; the vote itself was not audible, and an earlier motion for 5:30 was withdrawn.
The engineer will proceed with the lower Elizabeth Street cleaning quote, and the Howard Street 40B proposal stays on future agendas as a standing item.
The engineer and business manager will propose a flat reconnection fee of around one hundred dollars, to be voted on later.

why_it_matters: Sewer bill rules are changing: a new owner may soon pay for only the months of service rather than a full quarterly minimum, and the nine well-water properties may be offered an optional second meter.

The easement change needs a bylaw vote at Town Meeting, so residents may be asked to take a vote on it, and the Howard Street 40B proposal stays on the board's agenda as it could affect sewer capacity and cost.
